description: You work from home and study online courses in the evenings. You got a new Mac and want to set it up for focused, distraction-free work. Open System Settings and make these five changes: (1) set Appearance to Auto — the Mac should automatically switch between Light and Dark mode based on the time of day (this keeps your screen comfortable whether you work in daylight or at night), (2) set scroll bars to Always Visible in the Appearance settings so you always know where you are in a long document, (3) disable all User Interface sound effects in Sound settings so notification and action sounds do not disrupt your concentration, (4) turn off 'Show recent applications in Dock' in Desktop & Dock settings so the Dock stays uncluttered, and (5) change the Minimize window effect to Scale in Desktop & Dock settings (instead of the default Genie effect). All five changes must persist — the verifier reads NSGlobalDomain, com.apple.sound, and com.apple.dock.

metadata.scenario: productivity/home-office — setting up Mac for focused work-from-home and evening study
